findings.F1: The test's result is on the side the idea predicts but short of the bar: a mean unusual 3-day move of +0.17 % with t 0.76 over 1164 case days. My own reading on every 3-day grid bar with a positive forecast gives the same picture, +0.30 % with t 1.13 (2907 cases, 781 days).
findings.F2: The effect is spread thinly but mostly the right way across coins: 5 of 6 coins are positive at 3 days (XRP +0.80 % t 1.54, ZEC +0.48 % t 0.98, LTC +0.28 %, ETH +0.25 %, BTC +0.11 %), and only XMR is negative (−0.06 % t −0.19). No single coin's t reaches 2, so this data is too small to show the effect, not opposed to it.
findings.F3: The effect swings with the period, which drowns it: it is positive in 2020 (+1.23 %, t 1.54) and 2021 (+1.52 %, t 1.77), negative in 2022 (−1.19 %, t −1.66), and near 0 in 2018, 2019 and 2025 (each 89–106 days).
findings.F4: The 5-day rise carries the effect more than the range does. On rising bars, the top half of 5-day rises gains +0.87 % (t 1.58) on narrower days and +0.72 % (t 1.39) on wider days, against −0.05 % and −0.55 % for the bottom half. The range-multiple quartiles do not rise in order (+0.09 %, +0.56 %, −0.63 %, +1.05 %).
findings.F5: The graded effect shows only while the coin's 60-day return is positive. There, the top quarter of rise × range multiple gains +2.15 % over 3 days (t 2.07, 120 days), and the rank correlation of the product with the unusual move is 0.045. When the 60-day return is not positive, the top quarter gains −0.49 % (t −0.42) and the rank correlation is −0.001.
findings.F6: Per case, the unusual move (+0.17 %) is 0.9 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade, so the plain idea cannot beat holding after costs. The top quarter in F5 (+2.15 %) is about 11 times the cost.

ideas.name: wide-day strong run, more coins
ideas.idea: After a coin has risen over the past 5 days, the larger that 5-day rise and the wider that day's high-low range compared with its average daily range over the past 20 days, the more the coin rises over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A very wide day at the end of a strong 5-day rise is a reason to join or hold the run for 3 days, while a wide day after a weak rise gives no such reason.

ideas.idea: After a coin has risen over the past 5 days, only while its 60-day return is positive, the larger that 5-day rise and the wider that day's high-low range compared with its average daily range over the past 20 days, the more the coin rises over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A wide day ending a strong 5-day rise inside a 60-day uptrend is a reason to join the run for 3 days, while the same day in a falling 60-day market is no reason to.
ideas.name: wide strong run in uptrend
